title: 01. Limit as approach
meaning: Visual: two sides approach one white anchor. Math: limit is an approach value.

title: 02. Derivative as local slope
meaning: Visual: white point plus amber tangent. Math: derivative is slope at that point.

title: 03. Definite integral as area
formula: Integral_a^b f(x) dx = signed area under curve
meaning: Visual: yellow mass under curve. Math: integral accumulates area.

title: 04. Gradient descent as walking downhill
formula: new point = old point - eta * gradient f
meaning: Visual: cyan path falls into white center. Math: subtract gradient to reduce f.

title: 05. Vector addition
formula: u + v = diagonal of the parallelogram
meaning: Visual: cyan then pink equals amber diagonal. Math: component-wise addition.

title: 06. Rotation matrix
formula: R(theta) = [cos theta -sin theta; sin theta cos theta]
meaning: Visual: square turns without stretching. Math: rotation matrix preserves lengths.

title: 07. Projection as shadow
formula: proj_u(v) = (v dot u)/(u dot u) * u
meaning: Visual: white drop creates amber shadow. Math: dot product gives projected length.

title: 08. Eigenvector as direction that stays itself
meaning: Visual: highlighted directions keep their line. Math: Av equals lambda times v.

title: 09. Projectile motion
meaning: Visual: arc plus downward force. Math: y has a negative t^2 term because of gravity.

title: 10. Position, velocity, acceleration
meaning: Visual: three linked waves. Math: derivative turns position into velocity, velocity into acceleration.

title: 11. Energy exchange
meaning: Visual: amber and cyan exchange. Math: K plus U equals total E.

title: 12. Harmonic motion
meaning: Visual: same wave shifted. Math: phase moves the wave without changing its shape.

title: 13. Electric field of one charge
meaning: Visual: field radiates outward. Math: inverse-square field from a charge.

title: 14. Electric dipole
meaning: Visual: red and blue sources meet. Math: fields add by superposition.

title: 15. Magnetic field around a wire
meaning: Visual: concentric circles around current. Math: B decreases like 1/r.

title: 16. Lorentz force
meaning: Visual: cyan velocity and amber force meet at the charge. Math: cross product gives perpendicular force.
